3. get_servo_temps once a second when nothing is sent
≥ 60 °C: hold targets, stop, power off (#115)

div.div:
4. send_angles if the arm answered and there is a new target
read until the Atom's sync-write: 19.2 ms median, 28.0 ms p99
(echo_timeout 60 ms)

div.div: Owns: the port (/dev/ttyTHS1, exclusive), the frame encoder/decoder (positronic_protocol, ReplyAssembler), the order of every call: one thread, so no call can take another's reply. A turn is 10 ms at rest, ~27 ms busy after a send.
